title: Listen: A week in my life: connect the details
summary: Listen for two key details about a week in my life: connect the details.

lesson.title: Listen: A week in my life: connect the details
lesson.subtitle: A2 · Listening · 3 min

steps.fr: D'habitude, je travaille le lundi et le mardi. Cette semaine, je suis libre mardi parce que je vais à un atelier.
steps.question: Why is the speaker free on Tuesday this week?
options: The speaker is attending a workshop.
The speaker has no work this month.
The speaker is visiting a friend.
steps.explain: The speaker says je suis libre mardi parce que je vais à un atelier.

steps.fr: Je prépare ma liste de tâches le dimanche. Ensuite, je vérifie les heures de mon cours et de mon travail.
steps.question: What does the speaker do after making a to-do list?
steps.explain: The next action is checking the hours for class and work.
